title: Aeromagnetic survey of the U.S. Atlantic continental margin area 32-78
citation: Behrendt, J.C., and Klitgord, K.D., 1980, Aeromagnetic survey of the U.S. Atlantic continental margin area 32-78: U.S. Geological Survey Open-File Report OF-80-285, map scale 1:250,000.
notes: Offshore aeromagnetic total-intensity contour map of the U.S. Atlantic continental margin, area 32-78 (offshore South Carolina), viewed in the page image because the OCR text is garbled. It shows only magnetic contours (2, 10 and 50 gamma), flight path and survey specifications (survey altitude 1500 ft ASL, IGRF 1965 removed); there are no geologic units, structures, wells, sections or reference list. Magnetic contours do not fit the contour fields (structure or isopach), so nothing was recorded. SUBSURFACE: none.
